# Zhihu
> Zhihu is a Chinese knowledge-sharing platform for questions, answers, articles, videos, and creator communities.

Zhihu combines community Q&A, long-form publishing, creator tools, commercial services, and corporate disclosures. Its public web presence spans the main community site, Zhihu Column, legal policies, creator and business resources, and investor relations.

## Main Platform
- [Home](https://www.zhihu.com/): Main Zhihu entry point for questions, answers, recommendations, and user activity.
- [Explore](https://www.zhihu.com/explore): Discovery page for trending topics, popular questions, and featured discussions.
- [Hot List](https://www.zhihu.com/hot): Real-time ranking of popular Zhihu topics and discussions.
- [Topics](https://www.zhihu.com/topic): Topic directory for browsing subject areas and related content.
- [Roundtable](https://www.zhihu.com/roundtable): Curated themed discussions organized around specific issues and events.
- [Specials](https://www.zhihu.com/special): Special-topic hubs collecting related content around major themes.
- [Question Waiting for Answer](https://www.zhihu.com/question/waiting): Questions seeking new answers from the community.

## Content Publishing
- [Zhihu Column](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/): Long-form publishing platform for articles, essays, and creator-led content.
- [Column Square](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/columns): Directory of Zhihu Columns across topics and creators.
- [Creator Center](https://www.zhihu.com/creator): Creator workspace for publishing, analytics, and account management.
- [Video](https://www.zhihu.com/zvideo): Video content hub for short and long-form creator videos.
- [Live](https://www.zhihu.com/lives): Zhihu Live knowledge sessions and interactive paid or free talks.
- [Education](https://www.zhihu.com/education): Learning-oriented content and educational offerings on the platform.

## Community & Discovery
- [Topics Square](https://www.zhihu.com/topics): Browse and follow topic communities across disciplines and interests.
- [People](https://www.zhihu.com/people): User profile namespace for authors, experts, and community members.
- [Collections](https://www.zhihu.com/collection): User-curated collections of answers, articles, and other saved content.
- [Pins](https://www.zhihu.com/pin): Short-form posts and lightweight community sharing feed.
- [Search](https://www.zhihu.com/search): Search entry for questions, answers, articles, people, and topics.
- [Campus](https://www.zhihu.com/campus): Campus-focused community area for student and university-related content.

## Membership & Commerce
- [Zhihu Salt Select](https://www.zhihu.com/salt): Membership and premium content service for subscribers.
- [Bookstore](https://www.zhihu.com/pub/book): Digital reading and book-related content offerings on Zhihu.
- [E-commerce](https://www.zhihu.com/market): Marketplace and commerce-related content or product offerings.
- [Paid Consulting](https://www.zhihu.com/consult): Expert consulting and paid knowledge services on the platform.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://www.zhihu.com/help): Support portal for account, content, safety, and product questions.
- [Feedback](https://www.zhihu.com/contact): Contact and feedback channel for user support and issue reporting.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.zhihu.com/question/19581624): Public guidance on expected community behavior and participation norms.
- [Copyright Complaints](https://www.zhihu.com/copyright): Copyright protection and infringement complaint information.
- [Child Protection](https://www.zhihu.com/term/child-jurisdiction): Policy information related to minors and child protection.

## Policies & Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.zhihu.com/term/zhihu-terms): User agreement governing access, conduct, and platform usage.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zhihu.com/term/privacy): Privacy policy describing personal information handling and user rights.
- [Zhihu Rules Center](https://www.zhihu.com/term/rules-center): Central index of platform rules, governance standards, and enforcement policies.
- [Personal Information Protection Guidelines](https://www.zhihu.com/term/personal-information-protection): Detailed guidance on personal information protection practices.
- [Third-Party Information Sharing List](https://www.zhihu.com/term/third-party-list): Disclosure of third parties involved in data processing or services.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.zhihu.com/term/cookies): Information about cookies and related tracking technologies.
- [Intellectual Property Policy](https://www.zhihu.com/term/ip): Rules and notices related to intellectual property protection.

## Business & Partnerships
- [Zhihu Business](https://www.zhihu.com/business): Business-facing overview for advertising, branding, and enterprise solutions.
- [Advertising Services](https://www.zhihu.com/business/advertising): Advertising products and campaign solutions for brands on Zhihu.
- [Brand Partnerships](https://www.zhihu.com/business/brand): Brand collaboration and marketing partnership information.
- [Recruitment](https://www.zhihu.com/careers): Careers and hiring information for joining Zhihu.
- [Open Positions](https://app.mokahr.com/social-recruitment/zhihu): External recruitment portal listing current job openings.

## Investor Relations
- [Investor Relations Home](https://ir.zhihu.com/): Corporate investor relations site with filings and company information.
- [Financial Information](https://ir.zhihu.com/financial-information): Financial results, reports, and related disclosures.
- [SEC Filings](https://ir.zhihu.com/sec-filings): U.S. securities filings and official regulatory documents.
- [News Releases](https://ir.zhihu.com/news-releases): Corporate announcements and investor-focused press releases.
- [Events & Presentations](https://ir.zhihu.com/events-and-presentations): Earnings calls, presentations, and investor event materials.
- [Corporate Governance](https://ir.zhihu.com/corporate-governance): Board, committee, and governance-related information.
- [Stock Information](https://ir.zhihu.com/stock-information): Share price and market data for Zhihu securities.

## Corporate Information
- [About Zhihu](https://www.zhihu.com/about): Company overview and background information about Zhihu.
- [Join Zhihu](https://www.zhihu.com/careers): Company careers page for roles, culture, and hiring.
- [Media Kit](https://www.zhihu.com/brand): Brand assets and corporate brand information.
- [Security Response Center](https://security.zhihu.com/): Security vulnerability reporting and response information.
